build_uniform_quantize: build a python module to quantize PyTorch tensor weights over n bits using uniform quantization
build_uniform_unquantize: build a python module to unquantize weights from levels and scale back to float32 tensor
create_UniformQuantizer: create a UniformQuantizer instance to quantize a PyTorch model with configurable bits and QAT support
review_UniformQuantizer_model_size: review the UniformQuantizer model_size method to calculate non-differentiable quantized model size in MB
test_UniformQuantizer_qat: test the UniformQuantizer QAT pre and post forward training hooks for quantization aware training
